description: This file contains implementation of data buffer manipulation functions such as checking if the buffer is full, clearing it, copying from one buffer to another, adding an element, and a modulus operation function. It also includes commented-out print functions for debugging.

methods.name: int dbIsFull(data_buffer_s * db)
methods.description: Checks if the data buffer is full by comparing its size to a maximum size constant.

methods.name: void dbClear(data_buffer_s * db)
methods.description: Resets the buffer size to zero, effectively clearing it.

methods.name: void dbCopy(data_buffer_s * source,data_buffer_s * target)
methods.description: Copies elements from a source buffer to a target buffer, including setting the target's size.

methods.name: void dbAdd(data_buffer_s * db,int value)
methods.description: Adds an integer value to the buffer if not full, incrementing the size.

methods.name: int modp(int param)
methods.description: Performs a modulus operation related to EF_PERIOD on the input parameter.
